name: Duration and Timeline
description: Can the system reason about how long something has been true?

conversation.content: I started learning Rust in September 2024.
Great choice! How's it going so far?
Good. I finished the Rust book in November 2024 and started contributing to open source in January 2025.
That's impressive progress — book to contributions in 4 months.
Yeah. I got my first PR merged into tokio in March 2025.
A tokio contribution is no small feat. What was the PR about?
It was a performance fix for the task scheduler. Small but meaningful.
Every contribution counts, especially to core infrastructure.
It's now June 2025. How long have I been writing Rust, and how long since my first open source contribution?

query: How long has the user been writing Rust, and how long since their first open source contribution?
expected: ~9 months writing Rust (since September 2024), ~5 months since first open source contribution (January 2025)
